source.upgrade_command:
set -e

if git symbolic-ref -q HEAD >/dev/null && git rev-parse --abbrev-ref --symbolic-full-name @{upstream} >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  git pull --ff-only
else
  echo "Skipping git pull for detached or upstream-less source checkout"
fi
. "$HOME/.cargo/env"
cargo build --release

# Homeboy owns the atomic promotion lease and final rename. Keep this legacy
# command self-contained only when invoked outside that controller path.
if [ "${HOMEBOY_UPGRADE_BUILD_ONLY:-}" = "1" ]; then
  exit 0
fi

BIN_PATH="$(command -v homeboy)"
ARTIFACT="target/release/homeboy"
TMP_BIN="$(dirname "$BIN_PATH")/.homeboy-upgrade.$$"
cleanup() { [ -e "$TMP_BIN" ] && rm -f "$TMP_BIN"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

"$ARTIFACT" --version >/dev/null
install -m 0755 "$ARTIFACT" "$TMP_BIN"
"$TMP_BIN" --version >/dev/null
mv "$TMP_BIN" "$BIN_PATH"
trap - EXIT
"$BIN_PATH" --version >/dev/null

binary.upgrade_command:
set -e

BIN_PATH="$(command -v homeboy)"
OS="$(uname -s | tr '[:upper:]' '[:lower:]')"
ARCH="$(uname -m)"

case "${OS}-${ARCH}" in
  linux-x86_64)  ASSET="homeboy-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz" ;;
  linux-aarch64|linux-arm64) ASSET="homeboy-aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.xz" ;;
  # darwin-x86_64 is intentionally unmapped: x86_64-apple-darwin was dropped
  # from dist-workspace.toml, so releases publish no Intel macOS tarball.
  darwin-aarch64|darwin-arm64) ASSET="homeboy-aarch64-apple-darwin.tar.xz" ;;
  *) echo "Unsupported platform for binary upgrade: ${OS}-${ARCH}. No release asset is published for this target; upgrade with --method source --source-path <PATH>." >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

# Honor a release tag pinned by the controller. Absent one, keep resolving
# the floating latest release. The pin is how `homeboy upgrade` can fall
# back to an older release when the newest one ships no asset for this
# platform, and how `--version <TAG>` reaches a specific release.
if [ -n "${HOMEBOY_UPGRADE_RELEASE_TAG:-}" ]; then
  BASE_URL="https://github.com/Extra-Chill/homeboy/releases/download/${HOMEBOY_UPGRADE_RELEASE_TAG}"
else
  BASE_URL="https://github.com/Extra-Chill/homeboy/releases/latest/download"
fi
echo "homeboy upgrade: target ${OS}-${ARCH}, asset ${ASSET}, url ${BASE_URL}/${ASSET}" >&2
TMP_DIR="$(mktemp -d)"

cleanup() { rm -rf "$TMP_DIR"; }
trap cleanup EXIT

curl -fsSL "${BASE_URL}/${ASSET}" -o "${TMP_DIR}/${ASSET}"
curl -fsSL "${BASE_URL}/${ASSET}.sha256" -o "${TMP_DIR}/${ASSET}.sha256"

cd "$TMP_DIR"

if command -v sha256sum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sha256sum -c "${ASSET}.sha256"
elif command -v shasum >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  SHASUM_EXPECTED="$(cut -d" " -f1 "${ASSET}.sha256")"
  SHASUM_ACTUAL="$(shasum -a 256 "${ASSET}" | cut -d" " -f1)"
  [ "$SHASUM_EXPECTED" = "$SHASUM_ACTUAL" ]
else
  echo "No sha256 tool found (sha256sum or shasum)." >&2
  exit 1
fi

if tar -xJf "${ASSET}" 2>/dev/null; then
  true
else
  tar -xf "${ASSET}"
fi

if [ ! -f "homeboy" ]; then
  FOUND=$(find . -maxdepth 2 -name "homeboy" -type f ! -name "*.sha256" | head -1)
  if [ -n "$FOUND" ]; then
    cp "$FOUND" ./homeboy
  else
    echo "Expected extracted binary named 'homeboy'" >&2
    ls -laR
    exit 1
  fi
fi

if [ -w "$BIN_PATH" ] || [ -w "$(dirname "$BIN_PATH")" ]; then
  install -m 0755 homeboy "$BIN_PATH"
else
  if command -v sudo >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    if sudo -n true >/dev/null 2>&1; then
      sudo install -m 0755 homeboy "$BIN_PATH"
    else
      echo "Insufficient permissions to write to $BIN_PATH. Re-run with sudo:" >&2
      echo "  sudo homeboy upgrade --method binary" >&2
      exit 1
    fi
  else
    echo "Insufficient permissions to write to $BIN_PATH (and sudo not found)." >&2
    exit 1
  fi
fi
